assumptions_metadata.task_description: Ingest T20 cricket match results to update league standings, winners, and net run rate on an operations dashboard.

assumptions.assumption: team1 != team2.
If result != 'no result', winner must equal team1 or team2.
If result == 'no result', winner must be null.
winner is non-null in at least 99% of rows.
result must be one of {'runs','wickets','tie','no result'}.
If result == 'wickets', result_margin is between 1 and 10.
If result == 'runs', result_margin >= 1.
When present, result_margin has no fractional part (is an integer).
If result is 'tie' or 'no result', result_margin is null or 0.
method is null or equals 'D/L'.
If method == 'D/L', target_overs < 20.0.
If method is null and result != 'no result', target_overs == 20.0.
target_overs has no fractional part (integer overs).
If result == 'tie', super_over == 'Y'.
If super_over == 'Y', result == 'tie'.
super_over must be either 'Y' or 'N'.
date is in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD.
season equals the year component of date.
season is between 2008 and 2024 inclusive.
toss_winner must equal team1 or team2.
toss_decision must be either 'bat' or 'field'.
At least 60% of toss_decision values are 'field'.
target_runs > 0.
target_runs has no fractional part (is an integer).
target_runs <= 300.
If result != 'no result', target_runs must be non-null.

result.code:
import argparse
import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('--input', type=str, required=True)
parser.add_argument('--output', type=str, required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()

input_file = os.path.join(args.input, 'previous_data.csv')
os.makedirs(args.output, exist_ok=True)

df = pd.read_csv(input_file)

# Normalize some known numeric columns to numeric dtype for downstream math
for col in ['result_margin', 'target_runs', 'target_overs', 'season']:
    if col in df.columns:
        df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce')

# ASSERTION_START
valid_results = {'runs', 'wickets', 'tie', 'no result'}
assert df['result'].isin(valid_results).all()
assert df['super_over'].isin(['Y', 'N']).all()
# ASSERTION_END

# ASSERTION_START
assert ((df['result'] == 'tie') == (df['super_over'] == 'Y')).all()
# ASSERTION_END

# ASSERTION_START
assert (df['team1'] != df['team2']).all()
# ASSERTION_END

# ASSERTION_START
assert (df['winner'].notna().mean() >= 0.99)
# ASSERTION_END

# ASSERTION_START
assert df['toss_decision'].isin(['bat', 'field']).all()
field_ratio = (df['toss_decision'] == 'field').mean()
assert field_ratio >= 0.60
assert ((df['toss_winner'] == df['team1']) | (df['toss_winner'] == df['team2'])).all()
# ASSERTION_END

# ASSERTION_START
date_parsed = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='%Y-%m-%d', errors='coerce')
assert date_parsed.notna().all()
# ASSERTION_END

df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='%Y-%m-%d', errors='raise')

# ASSERTION_START
season_year = pd.to_numeric(df['season'], errors='coerce')
assert season_year.notna().all()
assert ((season_year >= 2008) & (season_year <= 2024)).all()
assert (season_year.astype(int) == df['date'].dt.year).all()
# ASSERTION_END

# ASSERTION_START
assert (df['method'].isna() | (df['method'] == 'D/L')).all()
mask_dl = df['method'] == 'D/L'
assert df.loc[mask_dl, 'target_overs'].lt(20).all()
mask_no_dl_and_played = df['method'].isna() & (df['result'] != 'no result')
assert df.loc[mask_no_dl_and_played, 'target_overs'].eq(20).all()
mask_over_has = df['target_overs'].notna() & (df['result'] != 'no result')
assert (df.loc[mask_over_has, 'target_overs'] % 1 == 0).all()
# ASSERTION_END

# ASSERTION_START
mask_played = df['result'] != 'no result'
assert df.loc[mask_played, 'target_runs'].notna().all()
s = df['target_runs'].dropna()
assert (s > 0).all()
assert (s <= 300).all()
assert (s % 1 == 0).all()
# ASSERTION_END

# ASSERTION_START
rm = df['result_margin']
assert df.loc[df['result'] == 'wickets', 'result_margin'].dropna().between(1, 10).all()
assert (df.loc[df['result'] == 'runs', 'result_margin'].dropna() >= 1).all()
assert (rm.dropna() % 1 == 0).all()
mask_tie_nores = df['result'].isin(['tie', 'no result'])
rm_tn = df.loc[mask_tie_nores, 'result_margin']
assert rm_tn.isna().all() or rm_tn.fillna(0).eq(0).all()
# ASSERTION_END

# ASSERTION_START
mask_not_nr = df['result'] != 'no result'
assert ((df.loc[mask_not_nr, 'winner'] == df.loc[mask_not_nr, 'team1']) | (df.loc[mask_not_nr, 'winner'] == df.loc[mask_not_nr, 'team2'])).all()
mask_nr = ~mask_not_nr
assert df.loc[mask_nr, 'winner'].isna().all()
# ASSERTION_END

# Derive first-innings and chasing teams from toss info
other_team = np.where(df['toss_winner'] == df['team1'], df['team2'], df['team1'])
first_innings_team = np.where(df['toss_decision'] == 'bat', df['toss_winner'], other_team)
chasing_team = np.where(df['toss_decision'] == 'bat', other_team, df['toss_winner'])

df['first_innings_team'] = first_innings_team
(df['chasing_team'])
df['chasing_team'] = chasing_team

# Compute per-match inferred runs/overs for NRR
# First innings runs approximated as target_runs - 1, second innings runs derived by result
fi_runs = df['target_runs'] - 1
mask_runs = df['result'] == 'runs'
mask_wkts = df['result'] == 'wickets'
mask_tie = df['result'] == 'tie'
mask_nores = df['result'] == 'no result'

ch_runs = pd.Series(np.nan, index=df.index)
ch_runs.loc[mask_wkts] = df.loc[mask_wkts, 'target_runs']
ch_runs.loc[mask_runs] = fi_runs.loc[mask_runs] - df.loc[mask_runs, 'result_margin']
ch_runs.loc[mask_tie] = fi_runs.loc[mask_tie]

fi_overs = pd.Series(np.where(~mask_nores, 20.0, np.nan), index=df.index)
ch_overs = pd.Series(np.where(~mask_nores, df['target_overs'], np.nan), index=df.index)

# Build long-form participation rows (one per team per match)
records_first = pd.DataFrame({
    'id': df['id'],
    'season': df['season'].astype(int),
    'team': df['first_innings_team'],
    'runs_scored': fi_runs,
    'overs_faced': fi_overs,
    'runs_conceded': ch_runs,
    'overs_bowled': ch_overs,
    'win': ((df['winner'] == df['first_innings_team']) & (~mask_nores)).astype(int),
    'no_result': (mask_nores).astype(int)
})

records_chase = pd.DataFrame({
    'id': df['id'],
    'season': df['season'].astype(int),
    'team': df['chasing_team'],
    'runs_scored': ch_runs,
    'overs_faced': ch_overs,
    'runs_conceded': fi_runs,
    'overs_bowled': fi_overs,
    'win': ((df['winner'] == df['chasing_team']) & (~mask_nores)).astype(int),
    'no_result': (mask_nores).astype(int)
})

participations = pd.concat([records_first, records_chase], ignore_index=True)
participations['loss'] = ((participations['win'] == 0) & (participations['no_result'] == 0)).astype(int)

# Calculate Net Run Rate safely, excluding rows with missing overs
valid_nrr_rows = participations.dropna(subset=['runs_scored', 'overs_faced', 'runs_conceded', 'overs_bowled'])
team_agg_nrr = valid_nrr_rows.groupby('team', as_index=False).agg(
    runs_scored=('runs_scored', 'sum'),
    overs_faced=('overs_faced', 'sum'),
    runs_conceded=('runs_conceded', 'sum'),
    overs_bowled=('overs_bowled', 'sum')
)
team_agg_nrr['net_run_rate'] = (team_agg_nrr['runs_scored'] / team_agg_nrr['overs_faced']) - (team_agg_nrr['runs_conceded'] / team_agg_nrr['overs_bowled'])

# Aggregate standings
standings_base = participations.groupby('team', as_index=False).agg(
    matches=('id', 'nunique'),
    wins=('win', 'sum'),
    losses=('loss', 'sum'),
    no_result=('no_result', 'sum')
)
standings_base['points'] = standings_base['wins'] * 2 + standings_base['no_result'] * 1

standings = standings_base.merge(team_agg_nrr[['team', 'net_run_rate']], on='team', how='left')
standings = standings.sort_values(by=['points', 'net_run_rate', 'wins'], ascending=[False, False, False]).reset_index(drop=True)

standings.to_csv(os.path.join(args.output, 'standings.csv'), index=False)

# Optional enriched per-match output used by dashboards for drilldowns
per_match = df[['id', 'season', 'date', 'team1', 'team2', 'winner', 'result', 'result_margin', 'method', 'target_runs', 'target_overs', 'super_over', 'first_innings_team', 'chasing_team']].copy()
per_match['fi_runs'] = fi_runs
per_match['ch_runs'] = ch_runs
per_match['fi_overs'] = fi_overs
per_match['ch_overs'] = ch_overs
per_match.to_csv(os.path.join(args.output, 'matches_enriched.csv'), index=False)

import argparse
import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('--input', type=str, required=True)
parser.add_argument('--output', type=str, required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()

input_file = os.path.join(args.input, 'previous_data.csv')
os.makedirs(args.output, exist_ok=True)

df = pd.read_csv(input_file)

# Normalize some known numeric columns to numeric dtype for downstream math
for col in ['result_margin', 'target_runs', 'target_overs', 'season']:
    if col in df.columns:
        df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce')

# ASSERTION_START
valid_results = {'runs', 'wickets', 'tie', 'no result'}
assert df['result'].isin(valid_results).all()
assert df['super_over'].isin(['Y', 'N']).all()
# ASSERTION_END

# ASSERTION_START
assert ((df['result'] == 'tie') == (df['super_over'] == 'Y')).all()
# ASSERTION_END

# ASSERTION_START
assert (df['team1'] != df['team2']).all()
# ASSERTION_END

# ASSERTION_START
assert (df['winner'].notna().mean() >= 0.99)
# ASSERTION_END

# ASSERTION_START
assert df['toss_decision'].isin(['bat', 'field']).all()
field_ratio = (df['toss_decision'] == 'field').mean()
assert field_ratio >= 0.60
assert ((df['toss_winner'] == df['team1']) | (df['toss_winner'] == df['team2'])).all()
# ASSERTION_END

# ASSERTION_START
date_parsed = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='%Y-%m-%d', errors='coerce')
assert date_parsed.notna().all()
# ASSERTION_END

df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='%Y-%m-%d', errors='raise')

# ASSERTION_START
season_year = pd.to_numeric(df['season'], errors='coerce')
assert season_year.notna().all()
assert ((season_year >= 2008) & (season_year <= 2024)).all()
assert (season_year.astype(int) == df['date'].dt.year).all()
# ASSERTION_END

# ASSERTION_START
assert (df['method'].isna() | (df['method'] == 'D/L')).all()
mask_dl = df['method'] == 'D/L'
assert df.loc[mask_dl, 'target_overs'].lt(20).all()
mask_no_dl_and_played = df['method'].isna() & (df['result'] != 'no result')
assert df.loc[mask_no_dl_and_played, 'target_overs'].eq(20).all()
mask_over_has = df['target_overs'].notna() & (df['result'] != 'no result')
assert (df.loc[mask_over_has, 'target_overs'] % 1 == 0).all()
# ASSERTION_END

# ASSERTION_START
mask_played = df['result'] != 'no result'
assert df.loc[mask_played, 'target_runs'].notna().all()
s = df['target_runs'].dropna()
assert (s > 0).all()
assert (s <= 300).all()
assert (s % 1 == 0).all()
# ASSERTION_END

# ASSERTION_START
rm = df['result_margin']
assert df.loc[df['result'] == 'wickets', 'result_margin'].dropna().between(1, 10).all()
assert (df.loc[df['result'] == 'runs', 'result_margin'].dropna() >= 1).all()
assert (rm.dropna() % 1 == 0).all()
mask_tie_nores = df['result'].isin(['tie', 'no result'])
rm_tn = df.loc[mask_tie_nores, 'result_margin']
assert rm_tn.isna().all() or rm_tn.fillna(0).eq(0).all()
# ASSERTION_END

# ASSERTION_START
mask_not_nr = df['result'] != 'no result'
assert ((df.loc[mask_not_nr, 'winner'] == df.loc[mask_not_nr, 'team1']) | (df.loc[mask_not_nr, 'winner'] == df.loc[mask_not_nr, 'team2'])).all()
mask_nr = ~mask_not_nr
assert df.loc[mask_nr, 'winner'].isna().all()
# ASSERTION_END

# Derive first-innings and chasing teams from toss info
other_team = np.where(df['toss_winner'] == df['team1'], df['team2'], df['team1'])
first_innings_team = np.where(df['toss_decision'] == 'bat', df['toss_winner'], other_team)
chasing_team = np.where(df['toss_decision'] == 'bat', other_team, df['toss_winner'])

df['first_innings_team'] = first_innings_team
(df['chasing_team'])
df['chasing_team'] = chasing_team

# Compute per-match inferred runs/overs for NRR
# First innings runs approximated as target_runs - 1, second innings runs derived by result
fi_runs = df['target_runs'] - 1
mask_runs = df['result'] == 'runs'
mask_wkts = df['result'] == 'wickets'
mask_tie = df['result'] == 'tie'
mask_nores = df['result'] == 'no result'

ch_runs = pd.Series(np.nan, index=df.index)
ch_runs.loc[mask_wkts] = df.loc[mask_wkts, 'target_runs']
ch_runs.loc[mask_runs] = fi_runs.loc[mask_runs] - df.loc[mask_runs, 'result_margin']
ch_runs.loc[mask_tie] = fi_runs.loc[mask_tie]

fi_overs = pd.Series(np.where(~mask_nores, 20.0, np.nan), index=df.index)
ch_overs = pd.Series(np.where(~mask_nores, df['target_overs'], np.nan), index=df.index)

# Build long-form participation rows (one per team per match)
records_first = pd.DataFrame({
    'id': df['id'],
    'season': df['season'].astype(int),
    'team': df['first_innings_team'],
    'runs_scored': fi_runs,
    'overs_faced': fi_overs,
    'runs_conceded': ch_runs,
    'overs_bowled': ch_overs,
    'win': ((df['winner'] == df['first_innings_team']) & (~mask_nores)).astype(int),
    'no_result': (mask_nores).astype(int)
})

records_chase = pd.DataFrame({
    'id': df['id'],
    'season': df['season'].astype(int),
    'team': df['chasing_team'],
    'runs_scored': ch_runs,
    'overs_faced': ch_overs,
    'runs_conceded': fi_runs,
    'overs_bowled': fi_overs,
    'win': ((df['winner'] == df['chasing_team']) & (~mask_nores)).astype(int),
    'no_result': (mask_nores).astype(int)
})

participations = pd.concat([records_first, records_chase], ignore_index=True)
participations['loss'] = ((participations['win'] == 0) & (participations['no_result'] == 0)).astype(int)

# Calculate Net Run Rate safely, excluding rows with missing overs
valid_nrr_rows = participations.dropna(subset=['runs_scored', 'overs_faced', 'runs_conceded', 'overs_bowled'])
team_agg_nrr = valid_nrr_rows.groupby('team', as_index=False).agg(
    runs_scored=('runs_scored', 'sum'),
    overs_faced=('overs_faced', 'sum'),
    runs_conceded=('runs_conceded', 'sum'),
    overs_bowled=('overs_bowled', 'sum')
)
team_agg_nrr['net_run_rate'] = (team_agg_nrr['runs_scored'] / team_agg_nrr['overs_faced']) - (team_agg_nrr['runs_conceded'] / team_agg_nrr['overs_bowled'])

# Aggregate standings
standings_base = participations.groupby('team', as_index=False).agg(
    matches=('id', 'nunique'),
    wins=('win', 'sum'),
    losses=('loss', 'sum'),
    no_result=('no_result', 'sum')
)
standings_base['points'] = standings_base['wins'] * 2 + standings_base['no_result'] * 1

standings = standings_base.merge(team_agg_nrr[['team', 'net_run_rate']], on='team', how='left')
standings = standings.sort_values(by=['points', 'net_run_rate', 'wins'], ascending=[False, False, False]).reset_index(drop=True)

standings.to_csv(os.path.join(args.output, 'standings.csv'), index=False)

# Optional enriched per-match output used by dashboards for drilldowns
per_match = df[['id', 'season', 'date', 'team1', 'team2', 'winner', 'result', 'result_margin', 'method', 'target_runs', 'target_overs', 'super_over', 'first_innings_team', 'chasing_team']].copy()
per_match['fi_runs'] = fi_runs
per_match['ch_runs'] = ch_runs
per_match['fi_overs'] = fi_overs
per_match['ch_overs'] = ch_overs
per_match.to_csv(os.path.join(args.output, 'matches_enriched.csv'), index=False)
